summary_zh: 设计、优化与维护与大模型交互的提示词及工作流，让 AI 稳定产出可用结果。
summary_en: Designs, optimizes, and maintains the prompts and workflows that drive large language models, making AI output reliable and usable.
why_new_zh: 大模型出现前不存在此岗位；自然语言成为新的编程接口后才规模化。
why_new_en: The role did not exist before large language models; it scaled only once natural language became a new programming interface.
human_angle_zh: 他们的一天在和模型「谈判」中度过：把模糊的业务需求翻译成模型听得懂的指令，跑几十次 A/B 对比，把失败案例归档成回归测试。同事眼里他们像驯兽师——知道这只「概率野兽」什么时候听话、什么时候跑偏。
human_angle_en: Their day is spent negotiating with models: translating fuzzy business needs into instructions a model understands, running dozens of A/B comparisons, and filing failure cases into regression suites. To colleagues they look like animal trainers — they know when the probabilistic beast will behave and when it will bolt.
examples: 企业内部 AI 平台团队

summary_zh: 构建评测集与自动化评估管线，量化模型质量、回归与安全性。
summary_en: Builds evaluation datasets and automated pipelines to quantify model quality, regressions, and safety.
why_new_zh: 模型能力难以用传统软件测试覆盖，催生专门的 evals 角色与工具链。
why_new_en: Traditional software testing cannot cover model capabilities, giving rise to a dedicated evals role and toolchain.
human_angle_zh: 别人问「模型变强了吗」，他们负责把这个问题变成数字。每天在设计刁钻的考题、抓回归、和「模型在评测集上作弊」斗智斗勇。模型每次发版，他们的仪表盘就是全公司最紧张的页面。
human_angle_en: When someone asks 'did the model get better?', their job is to turn that question into numbers. They spend their days writing tricky exam questions, catching regressions, and outsmarting models that game the benchmark. On release day, their dashboard is the most-watched page in the company.

summary_zh: 主动攻击模型以发现越狱、有害输出、数据泄露等风险并推动修复。
summary_en: Attacks models on purpose to uncover jailbreaks, harmful outputs, and data leaks — then drives the fixes.
why_new_zh: 生成式模型带来全新的攻击面（提示注入、越狱），需要专门对抗性测试。
why_new_en: Generative models introduced an entirely new attack surface (prompt injection, jailbreaks) that demands dedicated adversarial testing.
human_angle_zh: 拿工资的「越狱者」。他们每天换着花样劝模型说出不该说的话：角色扮演、藏话术、套密码，攻破之后写报告让防线变厚。是整个 AI 行业里少数「上班合法使坏」的职业。
human_angle_en: Jailbreakers on payroll. Every day they invent new ways to talk a model into saying what it shouldn't — role-play tricks, hidden payloads, secret-extraction games — then write up each breach so the defenses get thicker. One of the few jobs in AI where misbehaving is the job.

summary_zh: 负责以模型能力为核心的产品，平衡不确定性、成本、延迟与用户体验。
summary_en: Owns products built on model capabilities, balancing uncertainty, cost, latency, and user experience.
why_new_zh: AI 产品的概率性与成本结构与传统软件不同，需要新的产品方法论。
why_new_en: AI products have probabilistic behavior and cost structures unlike traditional software, demanding a new product playbook.
human_angle_zh: 传统产品经理管确定性的功能，他们管一个「大概率靠谱」的智能体。每天的决策长这样：幻觉率降一个点值多少钱？延迟两秒用户会不会跑？什么场景该让人接管？他们是把概率翻译成产品决策的人。
human_angle_en: A traditional PM ships deterministic features; an AI PM ships an agent that is 'probably right'. Daily decisions sound like: what is one point of hallucination worth? Will users leave over two seconds of latency? When must a human take over? They translate probability into product calls.

name_zh: AI 训练师 / 数据标注与对齐专家
summary_zh: 为 RLHF / 偏好对齐生产高质量标注与示范数据，提升模型对齐度。
summary_en: Produces high-quality labels and demonstrations for RLHF and preference alignment, making models follow human intent.
why_new_zh: 对齐训练需要大量人类偏好数据，催生专业标注与领域专家众包市场。
why_new_en: Alignment training runs on human preference data at scale, creating a professional annotation industry and an expert crowdwork market.
official_recognition: 人社部第二批新职业（2020-02）：人工智能训练师
human_angle_zh: AI 的「家教」。医生、律师、程序员坐在屏幕前给模型的回答打分、写更好的示范——模型的「品格」就是由这几十万次人类判断喂出来的。这是 AI 浪潮里最隐形也最庞大的新工种之一。
human_angle_en: AI's private tutors. Doctors, lawyers, and programmers sit at screens grading model answers and writing better ones — a model's character is fed by hundreds of thousands of these human judgments. One of the most invisible yet largest new trades of the AI era.

summary_zh: 确保 AI 系统符合法规（如欧盟 AI 法案）、内部政策与伦理标准。
summary_en: Keeps AI systems compliant with regulation (such as the EU AI Act), internal policy, and ethical standards.
why_new_zh: AI 专项监管陆续落地，企业需要专门角色负责合规与风险治理。
why_new_en: AI-specific regulation is arriving worldwide, and companies need a dedicated role to own compliance and risk governance.
human_angle_zh: 在「跑得快」和「别出事」之间踩刹车的人。他们读法案、盘点公司里每一个用了 AI 的系统、给高风险场景上流程，出事时第一个被叫进会议室。监管每落地一部法案，这个岗位就多一批招聘。
human_angle_en: The person whose foot hovers over the brake between 'move fast' and 'don't blow up'. They read the regulations, inventory every AI system in the company, gate the high-risk use cases — and are first into the room when something goes wrong. Every new AI law mints another wave of these jobs.
